headword: {兄弟姉妹|きょうだいしまい}

definitions.explanation: A gender-inclusive term for all siblings. Used in formal and official contexts to explicitly include both male and female siblings, unlike the more common {兄弟|きょうだい} which can be ambiguous.

examples.japanese: {兄弟姉妹|きょうだいしまい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many siblings do you have?

examples.japanese: {兄弟姉妹|きょうだいしまい}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧だ。
examples.english: It's been a long time since all of us siblings got together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{兄弟姉妹|きょうだいしまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please enter the number of siblings in the family composition section of the application form.

notes:
USAGE: {兄弟姉妹|きょうだいしまい} is the explicitly gender-inclusive term for siblings, combining ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧ (brothers) and ⟦{姉妹|しまい}→姉妹：03201_shimai⟧ (sisters). It is commonly used on official forms and in formal writing.

In everyday speech, ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧ alone is often used as a gender-neutral term for siblings regardless of sex, but {兄弟姉妹|きょうだいしまい} is preferred in official and precise contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {兄弟姉妹|きょうだいしまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧: number of siblings
- {兄弟姉妹|きょうだいしまい}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧: between siblings
- {兄弟姉妹|きょうだいしまい}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧: all siblings
